project_name.justification: The text states that SLAM Exploration Ltd. has entered into an agreement to acquire the project: "...to acquire a 100% interest in the Ear Falls lithium project..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: "SLAM Exploration Ltd. (TSXV-SXL) is pleased to announce it has entered into an arm’s length option agreement..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, SLAM Exploration Ltd., is identified in the text: "Mike Taylor P.Geo, President and CEO of SLAM Exploration Ltd., is a qualified person..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement allows for the acquisition of a full interest in the project: "To earn a 100% interest in and to the Ear Falls Lake lithium project SLAM must pay..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly identified as a lithium project multiple times, including in the headline: "Slam Acquires New Lithium Project" and the body: "...acquire a 100% interest in the Ear Falls lithium project..."

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The currency for the cash payments is specified as Canadian dollars: "SLAM must pay the Optionors a total of $79,000 CAD dollars over three years..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash consideration is stated in the agreement terms and confirmed in the payment schedule table: "To earn a 100% interest in and to the Ear Falls Lake lithium project SLAM must pay the Optionors a total of $79,000 CAD dollars over three years..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The agreement specifies the number of shares to be issued (300,000), but does not assign a total dollar value to this share component.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the payment are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total number of shares to be issued is stated in the agreement terms and confirmed in the payment schedule table: "...and issue the Optionors 300,000 common shares (Shares)..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The source text does not mention any share warrant payments.

option_payments_raw.justification: The source text does not mention any option payments as part of the consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.045'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The source text does not specify an exploration commitment in meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text states SLAM is "planning an exploration program at Ear Falls" but does not mention a specific monetary commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, the sellers retain a royalty: "Upon SLAM earning 100% interest, the Optionors are to hold a 1.5% Net Smelter Return (NSR) Production royalty."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the project is stated in the project highlights: "The project comprises 230 claim units covering 4,700 hectares in 2 claim groups..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares: "The project comprises 230 claim units covering 4,700 hectares..."

resource_size.justification: The text describes the project as being near new discoveries and mentions resources on adjacent properties, but does not state a mineral resource estimate for the Ear Falls project itself.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph of the announcement: "SLAM Exploration Ltd. (TSXV-SXL) is pleased to announce..."
